notes: Eighteenth run, Monday, weekly sources off. Lookback 7 days (2026-09-28 to 2026-10-05). The Sunday evening listing is in: 121 quant-ph submissions dated 2026-10-02 were retrieved. Yesterday's 17 unscored ids were ordered by date, then by id, and the oldest 15 were scored. Two HOLD (E-QEC only): continuous QEC thermodynamics on the repetition code, and a deformed toric-code norm. Thirteen REJECT: seven on the E-HOL denylist, and six off-path (fusion-category dimensions, a transmon exchange pulse, phase-only 'anyonic' symmetry, a lattice-Boltzmann syndrome, a graphene Floquet gap, and a Physics of Plasmas quasisymmetric-field paper). The OSTI record for 10.1063/5.0341763 returned no abstract; no number was invented. No ADD, no STRENGTHEN, no bridge, no new pillar, no CUT reversal. C unchanged. DBE-0.2.2 / DBES-0.2.0 stand. Q=1000 remains a ledger stress test. ingest.py was not executed: it fires seven arXiv requests with no sleep and would break the 1 request / 3 s rule. Its QUERIES were run with a 3.2 s gap. fetch_arxiv.py was not run in write mode. OpenAlex, Crossref, and Unpaywall skipped (OPENALEX_API_KEY and DBE_CONTACT_EMAIL unset). Dedupe included the 15 papers on unmerged PR #4 (observatory/2026-10-04) so this branch, cut from feature/research-grade-physics, does not open a second row for them. The two pull requests will both edit catalog.json. Harvest confidence uses round(raw x 0.88) for preprint tier 0.7 and round(raw x 1) for the journal. Popularity is 40 because Semantic Scholar was skipped; it is not a citation count. No PDF cached (DBE_FULLTEXT_STORE unset). Prompt freeze text matches the files: DBE-0.2.2 / DBES-0.2.0, claims freeze 2026-10-02. No suspicious instructions in fetched abstracts. Changelog section is 0.4.15 because unmerged PR #4 already used 0.4.14.
